# Kalapriti Designs

> Kalapriti Designs is an architectural & design consultancy working across exterior and interior design, from first sketch to styled handover. Principal consultant: Jitendrakumar Patel. Online-first studio — we work on site, across Gujarat and beyond.

## Pages

- [Kalapriti Designs](https://kalapritidesigns.com/): Kalapriti Designs is an architecture and interior practice working across exterior and interior design — from first sketch to styled handover.
- [Services — Architecture & Interiors](https://kalapritidesigns.com/services): Architecture planning, landscape, interior design and renovation — offered as advisory or end-to-end turnkey delivery. What we take on, and how far.
- [How a Project Runs](https://kalapritidesigns.com/process): The same six steps on every project — brief, concept, drawings, approvals, build and handover — so you always know what is settled and what comes next.
- [About the Practice](https://kalapritidesigns.com/about): An online-first architecture and design consultancy led by Jitendrakumar Patel, built around brand value and buildable detail. Across Gujarat and beyond.
- [Start a Project](https://kalapritidesigns.com/contact): Tell us roughly what you have in mind. The first consultation is a conversation, not a commitment. Call, WhatsApp or send an enquiry.

## Services

- **Architecture Planning** (Exterior): Spatial planning, massing and facade development, from first sketch through to the drawing set a contractor can build from.
- **Landscape** (Exterior): The ground plane treated as part of the building — approach, levels, planting and the transition from outside to in.
- **Interior Design** (Interior): Layout, materiality, lighting and joinery detailing for residential and commercial interiors, resolved to a furniture-level plan.
- **Renovation & Staging** (Interior): Working with what already stands — reconfiguring existing spaces, and presenting them to sell, let or hand over.

## How we engage

- **Design Consultancy**: Advisory engagement. We develop the design, the drawings and the specification; you appoint and run the contractors.
- **Turnkey Projects**: End-to-end delivery. Design, procurement, contractor coordination and site supervision through to a finished, styled handover.
